name: Wave Accounting
one_liner: Free accounting software for small businesses. Invoicing, expense tracking, and reports at no cost. Paid add-ons for payroll and payments.
short_description: Wave is a free accounting platform for small businesses including solo therapy practices. Core features like invoicing, expense tracking, and financial reporting are completely free.
long_description: Wave Accounting offers free invoicing, expense tracking, bank connections, and financial reporting for small businesses. For solo therapists who want simple bookkeeping without the cost of QuickBooks, Wave provides a solid free alternative. The platform includes unlimited invoicing, receipt scanning, and basic reports like profit & loss statements. Wave makes money through optional paid add-ons: payment processing (2.9% + $0.60 per transaction) and payroll services. Wave was acquired by H&R Block in 2019. While not as feature-rich as QuickBooks, Wave is ideal for budget-conscious solo practitioners with straightforward accounting needs.

pricing.notes: Core accounting is 100% free. Paid add-ons optional.

compliance.notes: Not HIPAA compliant. Use for financial data only.

seo.meta_description: Wave free accounting software. Invoicing, expenses, reports at no cost. Free alternative to QuickBooks for solo therapists.

faqs.a: Yes, Wave's core accounting features (invoicing, expense tracking, bank connections, reports) are completely free. They charge for optional add-ons like payment processing and payroll.
Wave is free but simpler. QuickBooks ($30+/month) has more features and integrations. Wave works well for solo practitioners with straightforward needs; QuickBooks better for growing practices.
